hero.subtitle: Your perfect Mediterranean escape. Villa Coco offers a heated pool, modern interior, and a relaxing atmosphere right by the sea.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A refined stay designed for comfort and calm.

description.paragraph1: Villa Coco is a modern and peaceful oasis in Kožino, located just 50 meters from the sea. It offers comfortable accommodation for up to 8 guests, with elegant bedrooms, spacious living areas, fully equipped kitchens, and modern bathrooms.
description.paragraph2: Your stay is completed by a private heated pool, terrace, and garden, perfect for relaxing throughout the season. Thanks to its proximity to the beach, shops, and seaside promenade, and with Zadar and Nin only a short drive away, Villa Coco is an ideal choice for families, couples, and small groups seeking peace, comfort, and Mediterranean charm.
description.paragraph3: Thoughtful details, airy interiors, and a quiet neighborhood create a setting where every day feels easy—from morning coffee on the terrace to sunset walks by the sea.

privacy.title: Privacy Information
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and process personal data in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.controller: Data controller: Villa Coco Kožino, contact via email: villacocokozino@gmail.com.
privacy.purpose: Purpose of processing: to respond to inquiries sent through the contact form.
privacy.legalBasis: Legal basis: legitimate interest and/or steps prior to entering into a contract.
privacy.retention: Retention: data is kept only as long as necessary to handle your inquiry and related communication.
privacy.recipients: Recipients: trusted service providers (hosting, email, and technical support) only when necessary.
privacy.rights: Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and data portability where applicable.
privacy.complaint: If you believe your rights are violated, you can lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (in Croatia: AZOP).
